description_expanded: The Triple Crown - Ultimate Pet-Friendly Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A Favorite Features: - Pets Allowed - Beach Views - Observation Deck - 3 Pools (Heat Available) - Elevators More about The Triple Crown: Combine all three homes—The Belmont, The Preakness, and The Derby at the Beach—for the ultimate group vacation, accommodating up to 42 guests! Just a 4-minute walk to the beach, it’s perfect for multi-family getaways and elegant celebrations. The Preakness at the Beach This 6BR/6BA gem features dual living spaces, a rooftop terrace with panoramic Gulf views, and a private heated pool. With a chef’s kitchen and plush king suites, it sleeps 14 guests in unmatched style. The Derby at the Beach A pet-friendly 5BR/6BA escape with Gulf views, a private heated pool, elevator, and outdoor kitchen. Enjoy alfresco dining and stunning sunsets with room for 14 guests. Book all three together as The Triple Crown for a grand coastal experience on 30A!
